page.layout: One column of running text, with short lines of paragraphs; a heading (Sectio X) in the middle of the column, below it the text continues to the foot. Marginal notes in the right margin: "Decima sectio." beside the heading, and "Offa pe-dum" beside the last lines. Bottom: signature "Z 3" at left, catchword "ossi-" at right, below the last line.

main_text.p: Digitorum autem ossa articuli sunt vel magni vel parvi.
Magni sunt articuli primi, singulorum digitorum quantitatis magnae.
Articuli primi committuntur vel brachialis, vel postbrachialis ossibus.
Articulus primus commissus brachiali est primum pollicis os.
Reliquorum digitorum articuli primi cum postbrachiali coarticulantur.
Parvi articuli digitorum sunt reliqui articuli digitorum, quantitatis parvae.
Eorum alii sunt minores, alii minimi.
main_text.head: SECTIO X. DE OSSE ILIUM, PUBIS, ET COXENDICIS.Decima sectio.
main_text.p: Hactenus de ossibus superioribus extremae partis trunci: Inferiora sunt, quae ab ima medii trunci parte enata propen-dent, reliquum superius totum & ere-ctum gestantia.
Ossa pe-dum,Suntq; ossa pedum, quae hic totam

page.notes: The heading's marginal note "Decima sectio." is placed inside the head element because no paragraph stands beside it. Printed long s was transcribed as plain s throughout (e.g. "ofsibus" as "ossibus", "fuperioribus" as "superioribus", "eft" as "est"). The marginal note "Offa pe-dum," is read with [?] doubt on its first letters; the text "Offa" may be the printed form of "Ossa". Catchword "ofsi-" read as "ossi-".
